payload.title: Randomized long-horizon coefficient meta-learning
payload.statement: Thousands of legal mask tasks generated only from outer-training wells, with horizons spanning the real hidden-suffix distribution, can teach a mask-conditioned nonlinear coefficient predictor that transfers better than four fixed within-well pseudo-cut summaries.
payload.evidence_for: T026 confirms that many legal masks add within-family information: the best mask-trained candidate improves the weak original-only comparator by 0.284538 RMSE. The last-known spline oracle remains 4.113743, and all corrupted controls lose.
payload.evidence_against: Every one of 76 fixed candidates is worse than exact E011. The best scores 12.625651, loses 0.074895, wins 0/5 maps and 8/25 cells, regresses three spatial and three typewell groups, and fails four of five horizon quintiles. Randomized targets differ from the source well's original target by 14.278922 pooled coefficient RMSE.
payload.next_test: Closed by D031. Do not retune mask-local end-of-well targets. Test a distinct target-preserving causal prefix-view mechanism under H020/T027.
